youtube_metadata.title: NVIDIA Buys Hugging Face for $12.9B: Open-Source AI Protected? #Shorts
youtube_metadata.description:
NVIDIA has agreed to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9 billion. With over 1.5 million models and 300,000 datasets, NVIDIA pledges compute neutrality for AMD, Intel, and Apple Silicon.
